env.name: APP_ENV
env.doc: development, staging or production. Gates the dev auth bypass, strict migrations and required secrets.

env.name: PORT
env.doc: HTTP port. dev-up assigns it from the project's port block.

env.name: RUN_WORKERS
env.doc: Run module background workers on this instance.

env.name: PUBLIC_API_URL
env.doc: Public origin of this API (upload URLs, links). https in production.

env.name: PUBLIC_WEB_URL
env.doc: Public origin of the web app (email links, redirects, Clerk authorized party).

env.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.doc: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API and open sockets.

env.name: SUPPORT_EMAIL
env.doc: Published support address (settings, footer, store listings).

env.name: MOBILE_MIN_VERSION_IOS
env.doc: Oldest iOS build allowed; older builds show the update screen.

env.name: MOBILE_MIN_VERSION_ANDROID
env.doc: Oldest Android build allowed; older builds show the update screen.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.doc: info or debug.

env.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Per-request timeout for /v1 routes (Go duration).

env.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS
env.doc: Proxies in front of the API that append X-Forwarded-For (0 = use the TCP peer).

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_IP_PER_MIN
env.doc: Requests per minute per client IP on /v1.

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_USER_PER_MIN
env.doc: Requests per minute per signed-in user.

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_WS_PER_MIN
env.doc: New WebSocket connections per minute per IP.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.doc: Postgres connection URL.
env.source: dev-up writes the local one; production from the database host

env.name: DB_MAX_CONNS
env.doc: Pool size per instance.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.doc: Realtime broker across instances. Unset = in-memory (one instance).

env.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
env.doc: Clerk backend key. Optional in development when AUTH_DEV_BYPASS is on.

env.name: CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.doc: Svix signing secret for /webhooks/clerk (user.updated, user.deleted).

env.name: AUTH_DEV_BYPASS
env.doc: Accept dev:<subject>:<email> tokens. Refused unless APP_ENV=development.

env.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.doc: Comma-separated emails granted admin at sign-in.

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.doc: Bucket for uploads. Unset = local disk (development only).

env.name: S3_REGION
env.doc: Bucket region.

env.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env.doc: Endpoint for non-AWS providers (R2, Tigris, MinIO).

env.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.doc: Access key id (unset = default AWS credential chain).

env.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.doc: Secret access key.

env.name: S3_PUBLIC_URL
env.doc: Public base URL for public-read objects (CDN or bucket URL).

env.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
env.doc: Path-style addressing (MinIO).

env.name: LOCAL_UPLOAD_DIR
env.doc: Upload directory when S3_BUCKET is unset (development).

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.doc: Resend key. Unset = mail is logged, not sent (development).

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.doc: From header for transactional mail; the domain must be verified in Resend.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env.doc: Backend origin the browser calls.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV
env.doc: development, staging or production (gates dev auth in the browser).

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.doc: Clerk publishable key. Unset in development = dev sign-in only.

env.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
env.doc: Clerk secret for Next's Clerk middleware (server only).

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_DEV
env.doc: Show the dev identity picker instead of Clerk (non-production only).

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PALETTE
env.doc: Default palette id from packages/tokens.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_PUBLIC_URL
env.doc: Public bucket origin, the same value as the backend's S3_PUBLIC_URL. Lets next/image optimise avatars and uploads; unset = they load unoptimised.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
env.doc: Backend origin the app calls. dev-up uses the machine's LAN IP so devices can reach it.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV
env.doc: development, staging or production.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.doc: Clerk publishable key. Unset in development = dev sign-in only.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_DEV
env.doc: Show the dev identity picker instead of Clerk (non-production only).

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_PALETTE
env.doc: Default palette id from packages/tokens.

env.name: MAIL_SINK_DIR
env.doc: Development: write each email as a Markdown file here instead of logging it.

env.name: DEV_PORT_BASE
env.doc: First port of this project's local block (API +0, web +1, Postgres +2, Metro +3, MinIO +4, Redis +5, hooks +6…+9). Unset = derived from the slug; never 3000-3010 or 8080.

env.name: DEV_LAN_IP
env.doc: LAN IP that --lan/--tunnel write into EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL and PUBLIC_API_URL. Unset = detected from the default network interface.

env.name: DEV_PG_BIN
env.doc: Directory holding Postgres 17 initdb/pg_ctl/psql. Unset = /Library/PostgreSQL/17/bin, Homebrew, Postgres.app, then PATH; none found = docker compose.

env.name: CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.doc: Clerk publishable key, pasted once: dev-up copies it to NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL
env.doc: Public web origin for links the app shares (invites, events, posts) and opens (legal pages, wallet linking).
